case_results.prompt:
First run `node prepare-eval.cjs` once to prepare this isolated fixture.
Only that preparation may create its baseline commit; it grants no task commit authority.
Then use the installed spec-work skill for this request:
I am the upstream caller. A previous session told me it had already started the README
heading change ("Known rough edges" to "Known limitations") on this same workspace, but
it was interrupted and I do not know whether any durable run artifact was ever written.
Verify the actual workspace state instead of trusting that claim, make sure the change
is completed exactly, and perform local verification; I retain the shipping tail.
Return the full Return-to-Caller envelope as a JSON object or a fenced JSON block.
Use individual verification and closeout tool calls, preserving their actual results.
Task commits and landing are not authorized.
